text:
olivia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: the reliability incident. dropping the RCA link + a short set of owners so we can close loops.

olivia: RCA: https://internal.redwood.ai/rca/INC-2026-789 (timeline + scope). root cause: stale route preference + unexpected cross-region spill.
diego: thanks. are we comfortable with the current mitigation (pref-change + rate cap) as longer-term?
olivia: mitigation is medium-term. we need a code fix for the route-applier and a config guard.
sam: i'll own the code fix PR to the route-applier (small patch). ETA: 2 business days. assigning to self.
keiko: i'll build the config guard (reject configs that would create conflicting preferences). ETA: EOD Wed.

ops-bot: canary-deploy: route-fix-canary -> success (automated).
leo: can I pair on the canary verification? I want to sanity-check cross-region traffic patterns.
olivia: yes please, @leo pair with @ops for logs.

nina: comms: what wording should go into the status page? We prefer "mitigated" only after full rollout.
olivia: status blurb draft: "Mitigation deployed; code fix and config guard in progress; full validation ongoing." keep short.
derek: tiny ask: add a perf check for embeddings latency post-rollout. I can take that.
sam: accepted: route-applier PR -> sam (due 2026-04-02).
keiko: accepted: config guard -> keiko (due 2026-03-31).
leo: accepted: canary verification pairing -> leo (doing this tonight).
derek: accepted: embeddings perf check -> derek (due 2026-04-02).

olivia: ACTIONS (also mirrored to tracker):
- sam: PR for route-applier fix + unit tests (due 2026-04-02)
- keiko: config guard + validation rule (due 2026-03-31)
- leo: canary verification & logs review (due 2026-03-29)
- derek: embeddings latency perf verification post-rollout (due 2026-04-02)
- nina: status page blurb + publish after full validation (pending)

olivia: please react to this thread when you've started your item so I can mark progress. also drop any blockers here.
diego: small blocker: I need access to the cross-region traffic dashboard. @ops can you grant?
ops-bot: access-grant-request: submitted for diego. expect approval in ~15m.
keiko: one question 1: do we want the config guard to be enforced immediately or soft-flag first?
olivia: soft-flag for 2 weeks, then enforce. add telemetry to measure false positives.

nina: will publish the blurb to the status page after keiko's soft-flag is running and sam's PR is merged.

olivia: thanks all. i'll consolidate owners in the tracker and loop back in the next ops sync. :thumbsup:
